Name: Quality Multi-Harvest
Author: DarkRobon
Description:
[b]Make the whole harvest count.[/b]

Harvesting a gold blueberry shouldn't leave you with one gold berry and a handful of normal ones.

Quality Multi-Harvest makes normal-quality extra crops from the same harvest inherit the first item's quality. If the first blueberry is gold, its extra blueberries will be gold too.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Works with multi-yield crops such as blueberries, cranberries, and coffee beans.[/*]
[*]Also applies to random extras of the same crop, such as bonus potatoes.[/*]
[*]Each later harvest calculates quality normally. A plant's quality isn't locked forever.[/*]
[*]Keeps existing yield counts and separate byproducts, such as sunflower seeds.[/*]
[*]Preserves non-normal quality already assigned to extras by another mod.[/*]
[*]Runs automatically, with no configuration needed.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.3.2 or later.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Quality Multi Harvest into your game's Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]When updating, replace the existing QualityMultiHarvest folder and keep only one installed copy.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
The mod changes normal-quality extras produced by standard crop harvesting. Mods that replace harvesting or generate their own drops may need an integration. Specific third-party mod combinations are not yet tested and will need testing on a case by case basis

If another mod has already given an extra item silver, gold, or iridium quality, that quality is preserved even if it differs from the first item's quality.

If the harvest change can't be applied safely, the mod logs a warning and leaves the incoming harvesting behavior alone.

For multiplayer , install the same version on every player's game.

[b]Uninstallation[/b]
Remove the QualityMultiHarvest folder and restart the game. 

[b]Reporting a problem[/b]
Include your full SMAPI log, the crop and fertilizer, your harvesting method, and the qualities and quantities you expected versus received. Mention any other crop, fertilizer, or harvesting mods you use.

[b]Version 1.0.0[/b]
Initial release. Initial testing found no issues. Broader mod compatibility remains to be seen and needs more testing.
